{{Youmay|the aspect of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] as taught by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]|the power [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]]|linebreak=1}}
{{Quote|&hellip;Sense involves the next step, in which the Jedi recognizes the Force in the universe outside herself.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bodo Baas]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Sense''' was an aspect of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] as they were taught by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After learning the foundations of [[Control]] as [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] apprentices advanced to become [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and broadened the scope of their Control abilities through those of Sense. Dipping into a deeper understanding of the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]], Sense abilities allowed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielders]] to immerse themselves in the environment. By the end of their apprenticeship, Padawans were expected to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as an additional sense and be constantly attuned to its undulations.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

The Jedi Order divided Sense abilities into four main groups: [[Life Detection|''prima vitae'']] (life detection), [[Sense Force|''tactus otium'']] (Sense Force), [[Psychometry/Legends|''tai vordrax'']] (postcognition), and [[Telepathy/Legends|projected telepathy]]. While there were many other styles to the Sense family, these were considered the most vital to Jedi teachings.<ref name="The Jedi Path" />
